analyticsAdmin.title: Analytics Center
analyticsAdmin.subtitle: One comparable view across web and Android, from discovery to sharing.
analyticsAdmin.accessError: Access denied or analytics are temporarily unavailable.
analyticsAdmin.qualityDescription: Before the platform field was introduced, Android is detected from the user agent. Future data is marked as exact.
analyticsAdmin.retentionDescription: Does someone who shows up once come back? D1/D7 pooled across all eligible cohorts.
analyticsAdmin.retentionScope: Active = at least one event on a given UTC day. Cohorts are left-censored at this window's start, and a rate is withheld below a minimum sample size rather than shown noisy. Respects the platform filter above (exact and inferred platform are never mixed here).
analyticsAdmin.viralCoefficientDescription: Completed Duel referrals per share attempt, by channel - joined through the anonymous link tag (TASK-33), not an identifying token.
analyticsAdmin.creativeVariantsDescription: Which framing (archetype reveal, moral radar, provocative phrase) actually gets the invite completed - deterministically bucketed per sharer (TASK-33).
analyticsAdmin.copyExperimentsDescription: Login prompt, home CTAs, challenge button, and Party create button - which variant of each actually gets clicked through, per anonymous identity (TASK-219/220/221/222).
analyticsAdmin.dailyDescription: A privacy-safe view of the Daily ritual from first view to sharing.
analyticsAdmin.dailyEventScope: Funnel counts respect the selected period and platform filter; each stage counts unique identities.
analyticsAdmin.dailyAggregateScope: This is the current global Daily aggregate across every platform, never individual choices.
analyticsAdmin.dailyAggregateUnavailable: The Daily aggregate is temporarily unavailable. Event metrics above are unaffected.
analyticsAdmin.partyDescription: A privacy-safe view of the Party Room loop, from entering a room to sharing the recap.
analyticsAdmin.partyEventScope: Funnel counts respect the selected period and platform filter; each stage counts unique participants.
analyticsAdmin.partyHostActionsDescription: Counted separately - only the host can take these, so they are not part of the per-participant funnel above.
analyticsAdmin.duelDescription: The Duel invite loop, from creating a challenge to viewing the comparison.
analyticsAdmin.duelEventScope: Funnel counts respect the selected period and platform filter; each stage counts unique identities across both sides of the invite.
analyticsAdmin.interactionsDescription: What people actually click, broken down by what matters - not just how many times an event fired.
analyticsAdmin.modeSelectedTitle: Mode picked from the home screen
analyticsAdmin.authPromptCtrDescription: Share of times the login prompt was shown that led to a click, by surface.
analyticsAdmin.trendDescription: Event volume and active identities in the selected period.
analyticsAdmin.funnelDescription: Unique identities per stage, combining historical and new events.
analyticsAdmin.timeZoneDescription: Time zone declared by the device; new-data coverage: {{coverage}}%. Historical data remains “unknown”.
analyticsAdmin.abuseDescription: Pseudonymized behavioral signals for identifying anomalous volume. A flag is not proof that a user is a bot.
analyticsAdmin.abuseThresholds: Watch from {{watchPeak}} events/min; suspicious from {{suspiciousPeak}} events/min or {{replay}} dilemmas within {{minutes}} minutes without reaching results.
analyticsAdmin.abuseGuardLimitation: The burst guard is intentionally zero-cost and works per Lambda container: it reduces common abuse but does not replace a distributed rate limiter or AWS WAF.
analyticsAdmin.abuseNoAnomalies: No anomalous pattern in the selected period.

consent.title: Your privacy choices
consent.body: Essential browser storage runs the game. With permission, Google Analytics measures aggregate web use only. We do not sell data, run advertising, personalise ads, or create cross-site advertising profiles; game results are processed to provide the feature itself.
